title: Unusual pattern confirmed by readings
reasonTemplate: The anomaly model scored your recent readings {anomaly.value:.2f} (unusual for you) and recovery strain has been rising ({strain.value:+.1f}σ). Readings confirm it: resting heart rate {resting_hr.z:+.1f}σ, fatigue {fatigue.z:+.1f}σ, sleep {sleep_hours.z:+.1f}σ from your normal.
disclaimer: Illustrative rule for the prototype. ML alone never raises an alert: the anomaly score and the strain trend must agree, a deterministic reading must confirm them, and the alert can only be Attention (TDD ADR-03). Measured on the simulated mission: 0 extra alerts for the healthy crew.
